name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover sewer water damage in my crawl space?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover sewer water damage in my crawl space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowner's insurance coverage for sewer water damage often depends on the cause. Sudden, accidental events like a burst pipe may be covered. However, damage resulting from neglected maintenance, such as long-term pipe deterioration or groundwater seepage, might not be. It is crucial to review your specific policy details and consult with your insurance provider immediately after discovering the issue.
